## 🧪 TDD & Verification Checklist
- [ ] **Red Phase Commit:** Added failing automated tests prior to implementation (`test(...)`)
- [ ] **Green Phase Commit:** Implemented logic and verified tests pass (`feat(...)`)
- [ ] **Automated Tests:** All unit/integration tests pass with 0 failures (`npm test`)
- [ ] **Security & RBAC Guard:** Verified unauthorized requests return `401 Unauthorized` or `403 Forbidden`
- [ ] **Data Integrity:** Monetary balances and transactions tested against overdraft / edge cases
